summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release titled 'Firmly on track to deliver FY guidance, driven by continued U.S. delivery and New Category momentum.' The release discusses H1 and FY2026 revenue growth expectations (now mid-teens), U.S. and AME segment performance, and New Category revenue growth. It is a routine business update with no indication of an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing constitutes an ordinary progress report on operations and guidance, not a special situation.
